entities.name: Buenaventura de Abarzuza y Ferrer
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Buenaventura de Abarzuza y Ferrer was a Spanish diplomat born in Havana in Cuba. He was an ambassador in London in 1873 and served as Minister of State between 1902 and 1903. He died on 13 April 1910.
